notes: Official figures are from Government of India press releases (PIB). Entries with "estimate": true are reference estimates used only where no official district or cost figure exists; the app labels them as estimates and lets the farmer replace them.

msp_history._comment: MSP in Rs/quintal by the calendar year the crop is harvested and sold (kharif year Y = marketing season Y-(Y+1); rabi year Y = marketing season Y-(Y+1) harvested in spring Y).

cost_a2fl_rs_qtl._comment: All-India weighted average cost of production (A2+FL: paid-out costs plus family labour) published with the latest MSP. Cost per hectare = this x all-India yield.

onion.yield_note: Maharashtra state average 2023-24 (about 86 lakh tonnes from 6.67 lakh ha, DA&FW horticulture estimate); district figures are not published in UPAg.
onion.usual_share_note: Approximate share of rabi/summer cropped area under onion in Pune and Ahilyanagar (horticulture area is not in UPAg district data).
onion.cost_note: Reference estimate for red onion on a small farm in Maharashtra (seedlings, fertiliser, irrigation, hired and family labour); no CACP figure exists for onion. Replace it with your own cost.

tomato.yield_note: Approximate Maharashtra tomato yield (horticulture estimate); district figures are not published in UPAg.
tomato.usual_share_note: Approximate share of cropped area under tomato in Pune and Ahilyanagar.
tomato.cost_note: Reference estimate for open-field tomato with staking and drip (seedlings, fertiliser, sprays, labour); no CACP figure exists. Replace it with your own cost.

potato.yield_note: Approximate Maharashtra potato yield (horticulture estimate); district figures are not published in UPAg.
potato.usual_share_note: Approximate share of cropped area under potato in Pune and Ahilyanagar (Khed, Ambegaon, Junnar, Shirur).
potato.cost_note: Reference estimate for potato (seed tubers are the largest cost, fertiliser, irrigation, labour); no CACP figure exists. Replace it with your own cost.

ginning_note: UPAg cotton yield is lint; mandi prices and MSP are for kapas (seed cotton). Kapas = lint / 0.34.
